title: Knockout Silky Saudi Arabian Vanilla Custard
description: A nutty and silky Saudi Arabian dish featuring vanilla custard, perfect for a sick day, served in a mason jar and gluten-free friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium saucepan, combine the milk, sugar, and salt, and heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has dissolved and the milk is hot but not boiling.
In a small bowl, whisk together the eggs and vanilla extract until well combined.
Gradually add the hot milk mixture to the egg mixture, whisking constantly to prevent the eggs from scrambling.
Stir in the melted butter, pistachio meal, and cardamom powder, if using.
Pour the mixture into 4-6 mason jars, depending on size, and place the jars in a large baking dish.
Add hot water to the baking dish to come halfway up the sides of the jars.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove the jars from the water bath and let them cool to room temperature.
Cover the jars with lids and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until chilled and set.
